dialogue.content: （宜しくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for being here.)

dialogue.content: (よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for seeing me.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。来ていただき、ありがとうございます。最初に、年齢・性別・ご相談内容を教えていただけますか?
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 38歳、男性です。
dialogue.English: I'm 38 years old and male.

dialogue.content: なんだか悲しくて
dialogue.English: I just feel kind of sad.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂き、ありがとうございます。悲しいお気持ちだと気分が落ち込んでしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Feeling sad can really bring your mood down, can't it?

dialogue.content: そのようなお気持ちになったのは、いつ頃からでしょう?
dialogue.English: About when did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.content: つい最近です。
dialogue.English: Just recently.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。何か、きっかけになるような出来事等、ありました?
dialogue.English: I see. Was there any particular event that might have triggered it?

dialogue.content: ここでは何でもお話して頂いて大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: You can talk about anything here.

dialogue.content: なんとゆうか持病のせいでやりたいことがやれなかったりして
dialogue.English: It's just that, because of a chronic illness I have, I sometimes can't do the things I want to do.

dialogue.content: 自分が情けなくなります
dialogue.English: It makes me feel pathetic.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。そのようにご自身を責めていらっしゃるのですね。持病…、とのことですが、具体的にはどのようなことでしょう?
dialogue.English: I understand. It sounds like you're being hard on yourself. You mentioned a chronic illness; could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.content: 責めてまではいないのですが、情けなくなったり悔しい気持ちになります
dialogue.English: I wouldn't go so far as to say I'm blaming myself, but I do feel pathetic and frustrated.

dialogue.content: 持病は何年か前に鬱病とパニック障害。今は自律神経失調症です
dialogue.English: The chronic illness... a few years ago it was depression and panic disorder. Now it's autonomic nervous system dysfunction.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。やりたいことがあるのに…。とちいうお気持ちなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're feeling, "There are things I want to do, but..."

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂き、ありがとうございます。そうでしたか。お辛い思いをされてきたのですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me. I understand—you've been through a lot.

dialogue.content: やりたいこと…、とは、何かに取り組みたいと思っていらっしゃるのですね?
dialogue.English: When you say "things you want to do," are you thinking of something you'd like to work on?

dialogue.content: 取り組みたいこともありますが、家事みたいな些細なこともできなくなるときが度々あるので
dialogue.English: There are things I'd like to work on, but there are often times when I can't even manage small tasks like housework,

dialogue.content: 情けなくなります
dialogue.English: and it makes me feel pathetic.

dialogue.content: すごく悔しいです
dialogue.English: It's so frustrating.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。それでも相談者様は出来る事をやろうとなさっているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... And yet, you are still trying to do what you can, aren't you?

dialogue.content: やる気だけはすごくあるのに
dialogue.English: I have all this motivation, but...

dialogue.content: 身体がついてこなくて
dialogue.English: my body just can't keep up.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…。
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お気持ちが焦っている感じでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Do you feel a sense of impatience or urgency?

dialogue.content: 焦ってはいないですね
dialogue.English: I'm not really feeling impatient.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。やろうとしても出来ないでしまうことが悔しいのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So it's the frustration of not being able to do things even when you try.

dialogue.content: そんなかんじです
dialogue.English: That's about right.

dialogue.content: お気持ちはあるのに、体がいうことを聞かない…。苦しいですよね。
dialogue.English: You have the will, but your body won't cooperate... That's painful, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 悔しいです、でもどうすることもできないので
dialogue.English: It's frustrating, but there's nothing I can do about it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。お気持ちお察しします。ちなみに、どなたかと一緒にお暮しですか?
dialogue.English: I can imagine. I understand how you feel. By the way, do you live with anyone?

dialogue.content: 妻と二人暮らしです
dialogue.English: I live with my wife, just the two of us.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。奥様とご一緒で。奥様は相談者様に対して、どのように接して下さるのでしょう?
dialogue.English: I see, so you live with your wife. How does she treat you, regarding your situation?

dialogue.content: 奥さんは病気ごと自分を理解してくれているので助かってます。
dialogue.English: My wife is very understanding of me and my illness, so that's a big help.

dialogue.content: 純粋に自分の内面の問題ですね
dialogue.English: It's purely an internal issue for me.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。とてもいい関係だと思います。そのように思われるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds like a very good relationship. And that's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: はい、自分とどう向き合うのか。そういった感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's about how I face myself. Something like that.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。難しいことのように思われますが、勇気をもってご自身と向き合おうとされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds difficult, yet you're courageously trying to face yourself.

dialogue.content: 常に自分と向きあいながら生きているのですが、やはり意思に対して身体がついてこない。ここにどう折り合いをつけていったらいいのか
dialogue.English: I'm always trying to live while facing myself, but my body still doesn't keep up with my intentions. I'm not sure how to come to terms with that,

dialogue.content: ここが難しいです
dialogue.English: and that's the hard part.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。折り合いが難しいのですね。悲しくなる…、とのことですが、やろうとしていることが、うまく出来ないことと、繋がっていらしたのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Finding that balance is difficult. You mentioned feeling sad—that’s connected to not being able to do the things you’re trying to do, is that right?

dialogue.content: まぁそうですね
dialogue.English: Yeah, pretty much.

dialogue.content: 何か行動しようとしても、体が思うように動かない。もどかしいお気持ちなのでしょうね。
dialogue.English: When you try to take action, your body doesn't move the way you want it to. That must be frustrating.

dialogue.content: それもあります
dialogue.English: That's part of it.

dialogue.content: 他に、どのようなお気持ちでしょう?
dialogue.English: What other feelings come up for you?

dialogue.content: 精神安定剤を処方されているので服用すれば動けるのですが
dialogue.English: I'm prescribed anti-anxiety medication, and I can function if I take it, but...

dialogue.content: 薬ありきな自分もなんだか情けなくなります
dialogue.English: ...relying on medication to be myself also makes me feel pathetic.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。そのようにお考えなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's how you view it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やっぱり自分で答えを出すものですよね、こうゆうのって
dialogue.English: In the end, these are things you’re supposed to figure out for yourself, right?

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうね。今は、少しでも症状が良くなるように、治療中なのですね。ご自身の体から造られないものを、お薬で補う、と考えられてはどうでしょう?
dialogue.English: Not necessarily. Right now you're in treatment to ease your symptoms, even a little. How would it be to think of medication as supplementing what your body can't currently produce?

dialogue.content: もう10年くらい心療内科に通院し続けてます。最初の数年はおくすりで日常生活が送れて仕事もいける。普通の生活がおくれるならそれでいいと思ってました
dialogue.English: I've been going to a psychosomatic medicine clinic for about ten years. For the first few years, with medication I could manage daily life and go to work. I figured that if I could live an ordinary life, that was enough.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ですが最近本当に自分がやりたいことがみつかって、次の段階にステップアップしたくて
dialogue.English: But recently, I've found something I really want to do, and I want to step up to the next level.

dialogue.content: それもあって病気や薬と向き合う機会が多くなり葛藤も増えています
dialogue.English: Because of that, I’ve had more opportunities to confront my illness and medication, which has increased my inner conflict.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。ステップアップを目指す、素敵なことですね。本当にやりたいこと、とは何でしょう?
dialogue.English: I see. Aiming to step up is wonderful. What is it that you truly want to do?

dialogue.content: 無理に話さなくてもいいですよ。
dialogue.English: You don't have to share if you'd rather not.

dialogue.content: 詳しい内容までは言えませんが自分にとって天職といえるかもしれない職業が見つかって今チャレンジしてます
dialogue.English: I can't share the details, but I've found a job that might be my calling, and I'm pursuing it now.

dialogue.content: ただそのチャレンジをすると症状が悪化して薬を飲む量が増える…といった葛藤があります
dialogue.English: However, when I take on that challenge, my symptoms get worse and I have to take more medication... that's the conflict I'm facing.

dialogue.content: 好きでやってることなのに体調が悪化していくのがなんだか…
dialogue.English: It's something I love doing, and yet my condition worsens—it just feels disheartening.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。天職…。心が躍ってしまいますね。目標に向かうのとご自身の病気と、一緒に考えていかなければならないのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Your life's calling... that's so exciting. You have to think about moving toward your goal and managing your illness at the same time.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そこが一致しないとゆうか反比例する感じなので悔しいです
dialogue.English: They don't seem to align—if anything, they feel inversely related—so it's frustrating.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。心と体が別々に行動してしまっているのですね。本当にしゃくに障りますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's as if your mind and body are acting separately. It's really aggravating, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 病気を治すためにいろいろやってきてはいるのですが、簡単に治るものでもないので
dialogue.English: I've been trying various things to get better, but it's not something that heals easily,

dialogue.content: 悪化しない程度にゆるくやってくしかないのかな…
dialogue.English: so maybe I just have to take it easy and go at a pace that doesn't make it worse...

dialogue.content: そうですよね…。でも奥様の理解もあって、とても良い環境だと思います。焦らず、あきらめないで、途中で戻りながらでも、一歩ずつ進んでいけたらいいなと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand... With your wife's understanding, it seems you have a very supportive environment. Without rushing or giving up, I hope you can keep moving forward one step at a time—even if that means sometimes stepping back.

dialogue.content: 諦めるつもりはさらさらないですね
dialogue.English: I have no intention of giving up whatsoever.

dialogue.content: そうでしたね。とてもお強いお気持ちをお持ちなのですね。
dialogue.English: That's right. You have a very strong resolve.

dialogue.content: 自分の向き合い方を確立するしかないですね
dialogue.English: I guess I just have to establish my own way of facing this.

dialogue.content: そのように思われます。年を追うごとに症状が緩やかになっていけたらいいですね。
dialogue.English: I believe so. It would be good if your symptoms could ease with each passing year.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそお話し下さり、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing with me.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: ご自身の病と折り合いをつけながらも、目標に向かって進んでいくお姿に、勇気を頂きました。
dialogue.English: Seeing you move toward your goal while trying to come to terms with your illness has given me courage.

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: Oh no, not at all.

dialogue.content: そんなたいした人間じゃないです笑
dialogue.English: I'm not that impressive, haha.

dialogue.content: 日々、辛く苦しいことがあると思います。無理せずお体を大切になさってください。また何かありましたら、いつでもお話しにいらして下さい。
dialogue.English: I imagine you have difficult and painful days. Please don't push yourself too hard and take good care of your body. If anything else comes up, please feel free to come and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ。お時間になってしまいました。これで終了とさせて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. It looks like our time is up. Would it be all right to conclude our session now?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
